alerts.backgroundNote: With the app closed, checks happen every 15–30 minutes — the most either platform allows.
alerts.backgroundNoteRemote: Your dashboard checks every time the car reports in.
alerts.chargeCompleteHint: When the battery reaches your target — or a charge ends at or above it.
alerts.chargeStartedHint: When a charge begins, with the time the car expects to finish.
alerts.chargeStoppedHint: When a charge ends below your target — a tripped breaker, a pulled cable.
alerts.deliveryFailed: Your dashboard couldn't be set up to send these, so this phone checks for now.
alerts.deliveryInsecure: Your dashboard can send these with Voltmoss closed once you connect to it over https://.
alerts.deliveryLocalBody: While Voltmoss is open, and from a home-screen widget every 15–30 minutes.
alerts.deliveryRemoteBody: These arrive even with Voltmoss closed and no widget on your home screen.
alerts.deliverySyncPending: Your dashboard hasn't taken your latest changes yet. It keeps sending the earlier ones until it does.
alerts.deliveryUngated: Your dashboard can send these with Voltmoss closed once it has a dashboard password.
alerts.deliveryUnsupported: Your dashboard can send these with Voltmoss closed once it's updated and push alerts are switched on.
alerts.lead: Voltmoss watches for these in the background. Each one tells you once, then stays quiet until it clears.
alerts.leftUnlockedHint: When the car is parked and not locked.
alerts.notifyChargeStartedBody: The car expects to finish around {time}.
alerts.notifyChargeStartedNoEtaBody: Your car is plugged in and charging.
alerts.notifyChargeStoppedBody: It ended at {pct}%. Check the cable or the charger.
alerts.notifyPanelOpenBody: Check the doors, windows, sunroof and tailgate.
alerts.notifyServiceDueBody: Open Voltmoss to book it in and schedule the next one.
alerts.notifyTyrePressureBody: The car is reporting a tyre out of range.
alerts.notifyVolt12LowBody: It reads {volts}V. The car may not wake up.
alerts.notifyVolt12LowNoReadingBody: The car reports a low 12V battery. Check it before your next drive.
alerts.panelOpenHint: A door, the tailgate, the sunroof or a window, on a parked car.
alerts.permissionBody: These alerts stay silent until you allow notifications for Voltmoss.
alerts.serviceDueHint: When the car reaches your service interval, by distance or by date.
alerts.settingsHint: CarLinko push alerts and Voltmoss reminders
alerts.socBelowHint: When the battery falls below your mark while parked.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.tyrePressureHint: When the car reports a tyre problem, or a wheel is out of range.
alerts.volt12LowHint: The battery that wakes the car. Flat, and nothing else matters.
